verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a consumer and business AI chat product like Grok, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented way to export conversations or account data in any format, open or otherwise. Being able to cancel a subscription and the fact that xAI stores prompts and responses on its servers are related points, but neither is an export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
